source: Official NTE 1.0.8.1102 client ZIP resources captured in R125

decision.reason: The Qt resource containers decode to launcher configuration, UI JSON/XML, images, and fonts. No text resource contains material, character progression, skill, ascension, or level data; these files cannot bind the held NTE material relations.
decision.nextEvidenceClass: Unreal client data or in-game export with versioned material identity, all stages, quantities, and consumer mapping
